The '''Battle of Yerej''' was a space battle fought between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] when the [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B frigate]] ''[[Meteor (frigate)|Meteor]]'' and its complement of snubfighters attacked the Imperial [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility|factory]] ''[[Drekker]]'', a [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]]-manufacturing facility in the [[Yerej system/Legends|Yerej system]].

==The Battle==
The [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Inexorable (Victory-class)|''Inexorable'']] responded to the attack on the space factory, launching [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]] to assault the ''Meteor'' and [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]] to escort the strike force upon entering the system. The factory ''Drekker'' deployed its own fighter screen, consisting of two full [[Flight group/Legends|flight groups]] of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]]. Planning for difficulty, the Imperials arranged that if the battle shifted to the Rebels' advantage, then two flight groups of [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transports]] could enter the battle and launch [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] at the ''Meteor''.

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
As players can participate in the mission "Attack on Imperial Factory Drekker" in the computer game ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter]]'' on either the Rebel or the Imperial side, both sides have conflicting mission objectives, and victory is not essential to access the next set of missions, the battle itself is considered canon but the canon outcome is unknown.

The ships listed in this article are those found in the battle [[Operation: Quick Strike]], using the default craft assigned to the player. The standalone combat engagement "Attack on Imperial Factory Drekker" is identical except for the craft, which may include [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]], [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]], [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]], and [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]].
